policy_references: Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending'
The user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.
If the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.
